--runtime builds the target's runtime before any app
control: a runtime that does not come up deploys no app
control: a target with no runtime record refuses --runtime

cases.id: a failed runtime build step answers it

payload.body: failed runtime build step 1: no zig

cases.id: --runtime carries every app's origins as CORS_ORIGIN, in apps order without duplicates
--runtime lays the target's stackEnv beside CORS_ORIGIN and a shared key takes the target's value
--runtime keeps the target's stackEnv when no app declares an origin
control: --runtime with no origins and no stackEnv carries an empty env
preview reads the file, composes an atom with the server program and deploys it named after --name
cases.note: With no substrate host the step's program/read fails inside step 0 and answers cannot-read, so step 0 pins only that nothing builds before the read; the later steps seed the run.
